description.content: Exercises the five chaincode functions via the REST API in cmd/api, signing in as each role in turn (patient tunde.adeyemi, laboratory lab.b, regulator regulator.e), plus the off-chain record route (/access/record) and role-based access control (requests 1b and 12). Every request has assertions, so a Newman run reports whether each outcome is as expected. Set {{baseUrl}} to the running API (default http://localhost:18080) and {{demoPassword}} to the demo accounts' password from postgres_auth.sql. Request IDs include {{runId}}, which request 0 sets to the current UTC time, because a real ledger keeps every request ID and rejects duplicates; run the whole collection in order so each run uses fresh IDs.
